What does this tell us?

These percentages describe practice in the app. They don’t capture every way your child learns or the support they receive at home. Discuss patterns with your supervisor.

EVERYDAY OPPORTUNITIES

Make room for a little practice.

Sample activity ideas to discuss with your supervisor.

🧩ASKING FOR HELP · 2 MINUTES

Build something together

During a puzzle or building game, invite your child to ask for a piece or help with a tricky step.

Explore this idea
  1. Choose a familiar activity your child enjoys.
  2. Give them time to ask. Offer a gentle example if they need one.
  3. Notice their effort: “Thanks for telling me what you needed!”

Keep needed help available. This is a sample idea, not a prescribed activity.

🎲TAKING TURNS · 3 MINUTES

Your turn, my turn

Roll a die, add a block, or take turns choosing the next page of a favorite picture book.

Explore this idea
  1. Pick a short, enjoyable shared activity.
  2. Model “my turn” and “your turn” as you play.
  3. End on a positive moment. A few turns are enough.

Something to bring to your next conversation

What felt easier this week? When did your child ask for support? Your everyday observations can help your supervisor understand the bigger picture.
